scope: CPU linear blend skinning of actual imported meshes at real runtime pose/target samples, plus offline independent-target combinations. Frontal actual-eye triangle rays are bounded visibility/closure checks, not exhaustive triangle collision or visual acceptance. Existing open-cornea obstruction is retained and separately reported by source validator. Held288 proof included only when exact source quad ring provided.
